MA-RD-F00-Q01.text: Let's begin. Read the sum on the card, work it out, and tap your answer.

MA-RD-F00-Q02.text: Have a careful read of the card. Solve it, then tap the answer.

MA-RD-F00-Q03.text: Read the number sentence on the card, then tap the answer you work out.

MA-RD-F00-Q04.text: Think about what happens in the sum on the card, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-F00-Q05.text: A short sum is on the card. Read it, solve it, and tap your answer.

MA-RD-F00-Q06.text: Count the pictures on the card. Then tap the number that tells how many.

MA-RD-F00-Q07.text: Look at the numbers on the card. What comes next? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-F00-Q08.text: Take your time with the calculation on the card, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-S06-Q01.text: Read the calculation on the card. Think about where you start on a number line, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-S06-Q02.text: Read the two numbers on the card. Think carefully about numbers below zero, then tap the symbol that makes it true.

MA-RD-S06-Q03.text: Which option is worth the same as the number on the card? Read it, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-S06-Q04.text: Same value, different form. Read the card, then tap the option that matches it.

MA-RD-S07-Q01.text: Read the equation on the card. What number does the letter stand for? Tap it.

MA-RD-S07-Q02.text: The letter on the card stands for a number. Read the equation carefully, work it out, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-S07-Q03.text: Read the ratio on the card. What number keeps both sides in proportion? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-S08-Q01.text: Here's a stretch question. Read the card, work it out, and tap your answer.

MA-RD-S08-Q02.text: Think about what the symbol on the card means. Then work it out and tap your answer.

MA-RD-T01-Q01.text: Count the pictures on the card, one at a time. Then tap the number that shows how many.

MA-RD-T01-Q02.text: How many can you see? Count them carefully, then tap the matching number.

MA-RD-T01-Q03.text: Point to each picture as you count. When you're done, tap the number you got to.

MA-RD-T01-Q04.text: Count the pictures slowly, then tap the number that tells how many there are.

MA-RD-T01-Q05.text: Take your time with this one. Count every picture, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T01-Q06.text: Count along the row from start to end, then tap the number that matches.

MA-RD-T01-Q07.text: Quite a few to count here. Go slowly, one by one, then tap how many you counted.

MA-RD-T01-Q08.text: Count each picture once, and only once. Then tap the number that matches.

MA-RD-T01-Q09.text: Lots of pictures in this row. Count them carefully, then tap the number you reach.

MA-RD-T01-Q10.text: A big counting job. Try counting in small groups if it helps, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T02-Q01.text: Read the sum on the card, work it out, and tap your answer.

MA-RD-T02-Q02.text: There's a number sentence on the card. Read it carefully, solve it, then tap the answer.

MA-RD-T02-Q03.text: Look closely at the sign in the middle so you know whether to add or take away. Then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T02-Q04.text: Work out the calculation on the card in your head or on your fingers, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T02-Q05.text: Your turn to solve one. Read the card, find the answer, and tap it.

MA-RD-T02-Q06.text: Start at the left of the card and read across. Work out the answer, then choose it from the options.

MA-RD-T02-Q07.text: Take a moment with the sum on the card. Work it out before you tap.

MA-RD-T02-Q08.text: Check the sign first, then work through the calculation on the card. Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T02-Q09.text: Number puzzle time. Read the card, work out the answer, then tap it.

MA-RD-T02-Q10.text: Bigger numbers on this card, so take your time. Read it carefully, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T03-Q01.text: Read the number sentence on the card. Is it true or false? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T03-Q02.text: Check the card carefully. Does the sum work out? Tap true or false.

MA-RD-T03-Q03.text: Read both sides of the card. Do they match? Tap true or false.

MA-RD-T03-Q04.text: Work out the calculation yourself, then compare it with the answer shown. True or false?

MA-RD-T03-Q05.text: Be the checker. Read the number sentence and decide whether it's true or false.

MA-RD-T03-Q06.text: Solve the card in your head first. Then tap true or false.

MA-RD-T03-Q07.text: Is the number sentence on the card right? Tap true or false.

MA-RD-T03-Q08.text: Read carefully and check the answer shown. Tap true if it's right, or false if it isn't.

MA-RD-T03-Q09.text: Time to check some maths. Read the card. Is it true or false?

MA-RD-T03-Q10.text: Detective work: read the sum on the card and check it. Is it true or false?

MA-RD-T04-Q01.text: Read the number sentence on the card. What number is missing? Tap it.

MA-RD-T04-Q02.text: Something's missing from the card. Read it carefully and work out what number goes in the gap.

MA-RD-T04-Q03.text: A number is hiding behind the question mark. Read the card and work out what number it is.

MA-RD-T04-Q04.text: What number would make the card true? Read it, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T04-Q05.text: Find the missing piece. Read the number sentence, then tap the number that fits.

MA-RD-T04-Q06.text: There's a question mark on the card where a number should be. Read carefully. What number belongs there?

MA-RD-T04-Q07.text: Think about what number would make both sides balance. Read the card, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T04-Q08.text: Working backwards can help here. Read the number sentence. What number is missing?

MA-RD-T04-Q09.text: Uh oh, a number has gone missing. Read the card and tap the one that fits.

MA-RD-T04-Q10.text: Can you find the missing number? Read the card carefully, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T05-Q01.text: Read the two numbers on the card. Which symbol makes it true? Tap it.

MA-RD-T05-Q02.text: Compare the numbers on the card. Tap the symbol that makes the sentence true.

MA-RD-T05-Q03.text: Look carefully at both sides of the card. Then tap the symbol that makes it true.

MA-RD-T05-Q04.text: Compare the two sides of the card. Which symbol belongs in the middle?

MA-RD-T05-Q05.text: Think about tens and ones as you compare the numbers on the card. Then tap the symbol that fits.

MA-RD-T05-Q06.text: Read both numbers carefully, digit by digit. Then tap the symbol that makes it true.

MA-RD-T05-Q07.text: Watch the digits closely on this one. Compare the two numbers, then tap your symbol.

MA-RD-T05-Q08.text: Work out each side of the card first. Then tap the symbol that makes it true.

MA-RD-T05-Q09.text: Solve each side of the card first, then tap the symbol that fits in the middle.

MA-RD-T05-Q10.text: Work out both sides of the card, then compare. Which symbol makes it true?

MA-RD-T06-Q01.text: Look at the pattern on the card. What comes next? Tap the picture that continues it.

MA-RD-T06-Q02.text: Find the part that repeats. Then tap the picture that comes next.

MA-RD-T06-Q03.text: Say the pattern quietly to yourself as you look. Which picture comes next? Tap it.

MA-RD-T06-Q04.text: Look along the pattern from the start. Tap the picture that keeps it going.

MA-RD-T06-Q05.text: Spot the repeating bit in this pattern, then tap the picture that comes next.

MA-RD-T06-Q06.text: Patterns repeat. Find the chunk that repeats here, then tap the picture that comes next.

MA-RD-T06-Q07.text: What would come next if this pattern carried on? Look carefully, then tap the picture.

MA-RD-T06-Q08.text: This pattern is a bit longer. Look for the part that repeats, then tap the next picture.

MA-RD-T06-Q09.text: Follow the pattern with your finger. When you reach the end, tap the picture that comes next.

MA-RD-T06-Q10.text: Pattern detective time. Work out the rule, then tap the picture that continues the pattern.

MA-RD-T07-Q01.text: Read which shape the card asks for, then tap the picture of that shape.

MA-RD-T07-Q02.text: The card names a shape. Read it, then find that shape and tap the picture.

MA-RD-T07-Q03.text: Which shape do the words on the card name? Read them, then tap the picture of that shape.

MA-RD-T07-Q04.text: Shape hunt. Read the card to find out which shape you need, then tap the picture.

MA-RD-T07-Q05.text: Read the card carefully, then tap the picture of the shape it names.

MA-RD-T07-Q06.text: What shape is the card asking for? Read it, then tap the matching picture.

MA-RD-T07-Q07.text: Find the shape name on the card. Then look at the pictures and tap the one that matches.

MA-RD-T07-Q08.text: Once you've read the card, tap the picture that shows the shape it names.

MA-RD-T07-Q09.text: Read the card, including the clue in brackets. Then tap the picture of the shape it describes.

MA-RD-T07-Q10.text: There's a little clue on the card. Read it carefully, and count sides if it helps. Then tap the picture that matches.

MA-RD-T08-Q01.text: Count each group of pictures, then pair it with the number that tells how many.

MA-RD-T08-Q02.text: Every number has a group that goes with it. Count the groups and join them to their numbers.

MA-RD-T08-Q03.text: Count the pictures in each group. Then match every group to the right number.

MA-RD-T08-Q04.text: These groups are close in size, so count each one carefully before you match it to a number.

MA-RD-T08-Q05.text: Take your time counting each group. Then connect each one to the number that matches.

MA-RD-T08-Q06.text: Count, then match. Every group goes with one number.

MA-RD-T08-Q07.text: How many are in each group? Count them, then match each group with its number.

MA-RD-T08-Q08.text: Big groups to count here. Try counting in twos or fives, then match each group to its number.

MA-RD-T08-Q09.text: Lots to count. Go carefully, group by group, and match each one to the right number.

MA-RD-T08-Q10.text: Count every group of coins, then pair each group with the number that matches it.

MA-RD-T09-Q02.text: Count each group on the card. Two of them have the same amount. Tap both of those groups.

MA-RD-T09-Q03.text: Count both groups. Are they the same or different? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T09-Q04.text: Look at the three groups. Count each one, then tap the two that have the same amount.

MA-RD-T09-Q05.text: Count each group carefully. Then tap same if they match, or different if they don't.

MA-RD-T09-Q06.text: Which two groups match? Count all three, then tap the pair with the same amount.

MA-RD-T09-Q07.text: Count the first group, then the second. Same or different? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T09-Q08.text: Count every group on the card. Find the two with the same amount and tap them both.

MA-RD-T09-Q09.text: Count both groups slowly. Do they have the same number of things, or different? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T09-Q10.text: Careful counting needed. Find the two groups with the same amount and tap both of them.

MA-RD-T10-Q01.text: Read the word problem on the card. Work out what's happening, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T10-Q02.text: There's a short story on the card. Read it carefully, then tap the answer to its question.

MA-RD-T10-Q03.text: Picture the problem on the card in your head as you read. Then tap the answer.

MA-RD-T10-Q04.text: Read the card slowly. Does the story add more, or take some away? Work it out and tap your answer.

MA-RD-T10-Q05.text: Find the numbers you need in the problem on the card. Then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T10-Q06.text: Read the whole problem before you start. What is the question really asking? Work it out, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T10-Q07.text: Pick out the important numbers as you read the card, work out the answer, then tap it.

MA-RD-T10-Q08.text: Story problem time. Read the card, think about what's happening, and tap your answer.

MA-RD-T10-Q09.text: Take this story problem step by step. The numbers are bigger, so read carefully before you tap.

MA-RD-T10-Q10.text: Detective reading time. Work out what the question on the card wants, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T11-Q01.text: Read the numbers on the card. Drag each one into the group where it belongs.

MA-RD-T11-Q02.text: Check the group labels first. Then drag each number into the right group.

MA-RD-T11-Q03.text: Sort the numbers on the card. Think about each one carefully, then drag it into its group.

MA-RD-T11-Q04.text: This card has a longer list of numbers to sort. Read the group names, then drag each number into place.

MA-RD-T11-Q05.text: Start with the labels on the groups. Then decide where each number belongs and drag it there.

MA-RD-T11-Q06.text: Look at each number in turn and decide which group it fits. Drag it into place.

MA-RD-T11-Q07.text: Take one number at a time. Check which group it belongs in, then drag it across.

MA-RD-T11-Q08.text: Sorting challenge. Read the group labels, then drag every number into the right group.

MA-RD-T11-Q09.text: Sorting time. Read the group names, then drag each number to where it belongs.

MA-RD-T11-Q10.text: Every number needs a home. Read the group labels, then drag each number into the right one.

MA-RD-T12-Q01.text: Read the question on the card and look at the number line. Then tap the answer that says where the number goes.

MA-RD-T12-Q02.text: Notice how the number line counts up. Then read the question and tap where the number belongs.

MA-RD-T12-Q03.text: Find the number's spot on the line in your head as you read the card. Then tap the answer that describes it.

MA-RD-T12-Q04.text: Check the marks on the number line first. Then tap the answer that shows where the number fits.

MA-RD-T12-Q05.text: Notice the jumps between the marks on the number line. Read the question, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T12-Q06.text: Study the number line on the card. Where would the number sit? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T12-Q07.text: Picture the number line the card describes. Then tap the answer that fits best.

MA-RD-T12-Q08.text: Look at the number line carefully. Read the question, then tap the answer that shows where the number goes.

MA-RD-T12-Q09.text: Imagine the line the card describes. Where would the number sit? Tap your best answer.

MA-RD-T12-Q10.text: Look closely at the marks on the line. Read the question, then tap the answer that says where the number goes.

MA-RD-T13-Q01.text: Read the picture graph on the card and the question under it. Count carefully, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T13-Q02.text: Look at each row of the picture graph. Read the question, then tap the answer.

MA-RD-T13-Q03.text: Go through the graph carefully, then read the question twice so you know exactly what it asks. Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T13-Q04.text: Count the pictures in each row of the graph. Then read the question and tap your answer.

MA-RD-T13-Q05.text: Row by row, read the picture graph. Then answer the question underneath by tapping your choice.

MA-RD-T13-Q06.text: Study the graph on the card. Read the question closely, count what you need, and tap your answer.

MA-RD-T13-Q07.text: Here's a picture graph to explore. Count each row, read the question, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T13-Q08.text: Count the pictures in every row of the graph. Read the question, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T13-Q09.text: Compare how long each row of the graph is. Then read the question and tap your answer.

MA-RD-T13-Q10.text: Don't miss the key on the card. Read it and the graph carefully, then tap the answer to the question.

MA-RD-T14-Q01.text: Look at the clock on the card. What time does it show? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T14-Q02.text: Read the clock carefully. Check where both hands are pointing, then tap the time.

MA-RD-T14-Q03.text: Look at the coins on the card. How much do they make altogether? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T14-Q04.text: Check the clock on the card. Which time is it showing? Tap it.

MA-RD-T14-Q05.text: Look closely at the clock. Where is the short hand, and where is the long hand? Then tap the time.

MA-RD-T14-Q06.text: Add up the coins on the card. How much is there in total? Tap your answer.

MA-RD-T14-Q07.text: Study the clock on the card, then tap the time it shows.

MA-RD-T14-Q08.text: Count the money on the card, then tap how much there is altogether.

MA-RD-T14-Q09.text: Tick tock. Look at the clock on the card and tap the time it shows.

MA-RD-T14-Q10.text: Coin counting time. Add up all the coins on the card, then tap the total.

MA-RD-T15-Q01.text: Read the sentences on the card carefully. Which answer must be true? Tap it.

MA-RD-T15-Q02.text: Read each sentence on the card slowly. Then tap the answer that has to be true.

MA-RD-T15-Q03.text: This is a logic puzzle. Read the card carefully, think it through, and tap the answer that must be true.

MA-RD-T15-Q04.text: Take your time with this card. Read it closely, think, then tap the answer you believe is correct.

MA-RD-T15-Q05.text: One clue at a time: read the card, then tap your answer.

MA-RD-T15-Q06.text: Logic time. Read the card twice if you need to, then tap the answer that must be true.

MA-RD-T15-Q07.text: Follow each clue on the card in order. Then tap the answer we know for certain.

MA-RD-T15-Q08.text: Put on your thinking cap. Read the card slowly, then tap the answer that must be true.

MA-RD-T15-Q09.text: Read the card like a detective. Which answer can you be sure about? Tap it.

MA-RD-T15-Q10.text: A thinking puzzle. Read every word on the card, then tap the answer that must be true.
